new_value: {"notes":"Implemented a clean authenticated operator alert sink in new coap_keys_alert source/header and existing clean CMake wiring. Mismatch audit records serialize to an exact 136-byte versioned envelope carrying sequence, timestamps, attempt count, prior delivery status, IID, pinned public key, and presented public key; keyed BLAKE2b authenticates the complete domain-separated payload. Initialization rejects absent/all-zero keys and registers the store callback; transport callbacks must durably accept or return negative errno. Backpressure/error propagates into existing pending audit state, explicit retry redelivers it, positive transport results fail closed, and accepted identical sequences remain replay-suppressed. Deinit detaches and wipes key/payload state. Decoder verifies exact bounds/version/flags/tag and semantic ranges atomically. Focused tests compile for nRF52840 and cover durable key-store non-mutation, payload fields, tampering/wrong authorization key/truncated-or-oversized frames, EAGAIN recovery, replay suppression, invalid registration, and reboot restore/rebind. Alert and test translation units compile with no leaf-local warnings; git diff --check passes. Dirty status/client/Kconfig files were untouched."}
